{{Documentation subpage}}

This is the navigation box for the [[FLLA World Cup]] and its related articles. Place it at the foot of any FLLA World Cup article, below the ''See also'' / ''References'' sections and above the category block.

== Usage ==

<pre>{{FLLA World Cup}}</pre>

The box is collapsible. By default it uses <code>autocollapse</code> (collapsed when two or more navboxes appear on the same page). To force a state, pass the <code>state</code> parameter:

<pre>{{FLLA World Cup|state=collapsed}}
{{FLLA World Cup|state=expanded}}</pre>

== Notes ==

* Editions marked <sup>†</sup> ([[1664 FLLA World Cup|1664]], [[1688 FLLA World Cup|1688]], [[1692 FLLA World Cup|1692]], [[1696 FLLA World Cup|1696]]) were awarded but never contested because of the [[Great Imperial War]] and the [[Red War]]; they are shown unlinked.
* The [[1772 FLLA World Cup|1772]] and [[1776 FLLA World Cup|1776]] editions have confirmed hosts but no article yet.
* Trophy, award and symbol entries point to sections of the main [[FLLA World Cup]] article until standalone articles exist.
